name: Summer Camp at the Y in BTV
description_short: Weekday day camp at the Greater Burlington YMCA for kids who have finished kindergarten, up to age 10. Campers swim in the Y pool, do arts and crafts and STEAM activities, play games in the gym, and go on walking field trips around Burlington.
refund_policy_summary: The $30 registration fee and $25 weekly deposits are non-refundable. Cancellations and schedule changes must be made two weeks before camp starts, and full tuition is due May 1. If the Y cancels a whole week, the amount is credited to a later week or refunded; if a scholarship still leaves camp unaffordable and the family cancels, the fee and deposit are refunded.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim in the YMCA's indoor pool during the week. The page gives no details on swim testing or supervision.
